author: Play On Tabletop
description:
Today's episode is sponsored by https://www.snotgoblingaming.com/ and their amazing FutureProof Terrain. Think Lego but for tabletop Terrain! You can flip and re arrange pieces both horizontally and vertically! It conveniently fits in a shoe box and is available pre painted! Just unpack, configure it how you want and you can get to playing right away!

A new Gauntlet begins as Aiden joins the Play on Tabletop team. As a seasoned competitive Thousand Sons player his first challenge is to go up against Tycho and solve the Riddle of the Norns! Does Aiden have the answer or will the riddle leave him puzzled?
